terms.meaning: The menu of links that moves the user between parts of the app.
Primary links are the main workflow. Context links are supporting pages.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test imports
sections.what: Brings in the test tools and the navigation helper.
sections.why: Gives the test what it needs to check the menu.
sections.watch_out: The imported name must match the export in the shell file.

sections.name: case navigation sections
sections.title: Navigation order and link checks
sections.what: Checks that the primary items appear in the expected order, that the context items appear in their expected order, that every link begins with the demo case path, and that the earth observation link is correct.
sections.why: Keeps the menu order and links stable so users reach the right pages.
sections.watch_out: The expected lists are fixed here, so any menu change needs this test updated.

summary: Tests that the case navigation lists the core items and the context items, and that every link belongs to the same case.
purpose: Confirms the menu order and that links for a case stay on that case's pages.
why: Likely reason: wrong links would send the user to the wrong case or to a missing page. Reason partly stated in the test name.
how: Builds the navigation for one demo case, then checks the order of the primary keys and the context keys, that every link starts with the case path, and that the earth observation link points to the right page.
inputs: The navigation helper and a demo case ID.
risks: Adding or renaming a menu item means updating these expected lists.
debug: If a test fails, compare the actual key list with the expected list in the file.
